name: Egg Omelet
description: A quick and fluffy 2-egg omelet, simply seasoned and cooked in butter.
instructions: Beat 2 eggs in a bowl and season with salt and pepper.
Heat butter in a pan over medium heat, pour in the eggs and cook until set.
Fold the omelet and serve hot.

name: Chicken Soup
description: A comforting, hearty broth-based soup with tender chicken and vegetables.
instructions: Place chicken, carrots, celery, and onions in a pot with water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Add noodles if desired and cook until tender.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: A classic Italian pasta dish with a rich, slow-simmered beef and tomato sauce.
instructions: Brown 400g minced beef in a pan with chopped onion and 2 garlic cloves.
Add crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, salt, pepper, and dried oregano. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook spaghetti according to package instructions until al dente, then drain.
Serve the spaghetti topped with the sauce and grated Parmesan.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
description: A creamy, blended tomato soup infused with fresh basil, perfect with crusty bread.
instructions: Sauté chopped onion and 2 garlic cloves in olive oil until soft.
Add 600g chopped tomatoes and 400ml vegetable broth. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth, then stir in fresh basil, salt, and pepper. Serve with crusty bread.

name: Banana Pancakes
description: Soft, fluffy pancakes made with ripe mashed bananas, great for breakfast.
instructions: Mash 2 ripe bananas in a bowl. Mix in 2 eggs, 1/2 cup flour, 1/2 cup milk, and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Heat a lightly buttered pan over medium heat. Pour small ladles of batter and cook until bubbles form, then flip.
Cook until golden on both sides. Serve with honey or maple syrup.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
description: A golden, crispy buttered sandwich oozing with melted cheese.
instructions: Butter one side of each of 2 bread slices. Place one slice butter-side-down in a pan over medium heat.
Layer with 2 slices of cheese and top with the second slice butter-side-up. Cook 3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese has melted. Serve immediately.

name: Chicken Stir-Fry
description: A quick, colorful stir-fry of chicken and crisp vegetables in a savory soy-sesame sauce.
instructions: Slice 500g chicken breast thin. Heat oil in a wok over high heat and cook chicken for 5 minutes.
Add sliced bell peppers, carrots, and broccoli. Stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Mix 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, and 1 tsp sesame oil; pour over vegetables. Toss well and serve over steamed rice.

name: Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal
description: Warm, creamy oatmeal sweetened with honey and spiced with cinnamon and fresh apple.
instructions: Bring 2 cups of milk to a gentle simmer. Stir in 1 cup rolled oats and cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Dice 1 apple and add it along with 1 tsp cinnamon and a pinch of salt. Cook 2 more minutes.
Sweeten with honey and serve warm.

name: Vegetable Stew
description: A hearty, slow-simmered stew loaded with root vegetables in a savory tomato broth.
instructions: Dice and sauté an onion and 2 garlic cloves in olive oil until soft.
Add diced potatoes, carrots, celery, and zucchini. Pour in 600ml vegetable broth and a can of diced tomatoes.
Season with thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper. Simmer 30 minutes until vegetables are tender.

name: Caprese Salad
description: A fresh Italian salad of tomatoes, mozzarella, and basil drizzled with olive oil and balsamic.
instructions: Slice 3 large tomatoes and 200g fresh mozzarella into rounds.
Alternate tomato and mozzarella slices on a plate. Tuck fresh basil leaves between slices.
Drizzle with extra-virgin olive oil and balsamic glaze. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper.

name: Pasta Carbonara
description: A creamy Italian pasta with crispy bacon, eggs, and Parmesan.
instructions: Boil spaghetti in salted water according to package instructions.
Meanwhile, cook bacon in a pan until lightly browned. In a bowl, whisk eggs with sour cream and grated Parmesan.
Drain pasta and immediately toss with the bacon and egg mixture. Season with salt and pepper. Finish with extra Parmesan.

name: Pasta with Tomato and Mushroom Sauce
description: A comforting pasta tossed in a savory tomato and mushroom sauce.
instructions: Boil pasta in salted water according to package instructions.
Sauté a chopped onion in oil, then add mushrooms and cook until tender. Stir in tomato sauce and simmer until creamy.
Drain pasta and mix with the sauce. Sprinkle with grated Parmesan to serve.

name: Green Salad with Tuna and Corn
description: A light, refreshing salad with lettuce, tuna, and sweet corn.
instructions: Wash and tear lettuce leaves into a bowl. Drain the canned tuna and corn, then add them to the salad.
Drizzle with olive oil and freshly squeezed lemon juice. Season with salt and toss gently to combine.

name: Cheese and Herb Omelet
description: A fluffy omelet packed with melted cheese and fresh herbs.
instructions: Beat 3–4 eggs in a deep bowl. Stir in grated cheese and finely chopped fresh herbs (spring onion, green garlic, or dill). Season with salt.
Heat a drizzle of extra-virgin olive oil in a pan, pour in the mixture, and cook over medium heat for about 15 minutes until set.

name: Asian-Style Rice with Chicken
description: Fragrant rice paired with grilled chicken and a splash of soy sauce.
instructions: Cook rice in a rice cooker with 2 tbsp oil and water according to package directions.
Meanwhile, grill chicken breast on a grill pan until cooked through. Dice the chicken into small cubes.
When rice is done, mix with the chicken and drizzle soy sauce to taste.

name: Turkey Breast on a Bed of Vegetables
description: Oven-baked turkey breast served over a bed of roasted vegetables.
instructions: Line a baking tray with parchment paper. Spread frozen vegetables over it and drizzle with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Lay turkey breast slices on top and season with salt. Bake in a preheated oven until the turkey is golden and cooked through.

name: Cream of Mushroom Soup
description: A smooth, velvety mushroom soup blended with cream.
instructions: Clean 1 kg of champignon mushrooms and boil them in water until tender. Finely chop one large onion.
Drain the mushrooms and place them in a blender together with the onion and cooking cream. Blend until smooth and creamy.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

name: Chicken and Cheese Puff Pastry Braid
description: A golden, flaky pastry braid filled with chicken, mushrooms, and cheese.
instructions: Dice chicken breast into small cubes and lightly brown in a pan. Roll out puff pastry dough.
Place the chicken, canned mushrooms, and grated cheese down the center. Season with salt and pepper.
Fold the dough over in a braid shape, brush the top with beaten egg, and bake until golden and crispy.

name: Flatbread Pizza
description: Quick and crispy flatbread pizzas topped with cheese and savory toppings.
instructions: Place flatbreads on a parchment-lined baking tray. Spread tomato sauce over each one.
Top with bacon, mushrooms, olives, and corn to taste. Sprinkle generously with grated cheese. Bake in a preheated oven until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

name: Chicken Skewers in a Pan
description: Juicy chicken and vegetable skewers pan-grilled to perfection.
instructions: Thread cubed chicken breast, red bell pepper, mushrooms, cherry tomatoes, olives, and onion onto skewer sticks. Season with a pinch of salt.
Cook the skewers in a grill pan, turning occasionally, until the chicken is browned and cooked through.

name: Crispy Sandwich
description: A toasted, oven-baked sandwich stuffed with ham, cheese, and fresh veggies.
instructions: Toast 2 slices of bread, then spread with butter. Layer with pressed ham and plenty of cheese slices.
Add fresh lettuce and sliced cucumber for freshness. Top with grated cheese and bake in the oven on a flat tray for about 10 minutes until the cheese has melted.

name: French Potato Pudding
description: A baked potato and cheese casserole enriched with eggs and butter.
instructions: Wash and dice potatoes into small cubes; boil until tender.
Transfer to an oven-safe dish and mix with grated telemea cheese, well-beaten eggs, butter, and a pinch of salt. Bake in the oven until the top is nicely browned.

name: Rice with Mexican Vegetables
description: Fluffy rice tossed with buttery sautéed mixed vegetables.
instructions: Boil long-grain rice in salted water until cooked. Meanwhile, sauté fresh or frozen mixed vegetables in a pan with a knob of butter until tender.
Combine the cooked rice and vegetables, season with salt and pepper, and serve hot.

name: Chicken with Mushrooms in Cream Sauce
description: Tender chicken and mushrooms simmered in a rich, creamy sauce.
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into cubes. In a pan with oil, brown the meat over medium heat, stirring frequently. Remove the chicken to a plate.
In the same pan, sauté the finely chopped onion for 2-3 minutes. Add the sliced mushrooms, season with salt and pepper, and cook until golden.
Pour in 400 ml of heavy cream and cook for a few minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
Add the chicken back and stir well. Sprinkle with freshly chopped parsley, cover with a lid, and leave for 2-3 minutes. Serve warm.

name: Pork and Potato Stew
description: A slow-cooked stew of pork, bacon, and potatoes in a savory tomato broth.
instructions: Cut the pork neck into cubes and coat them in flour. Place in a pot together with the diced smoked bacon and a little oil. Brown the meat well on all sides, then set aside.
In the same oil, sauté the diced onion for 2 minutes. Add the minced garlic and sliced carrot, and sauté for another 1-2 minutes.

Add the tomato sauce, browned meat, and 500 ml of clear broth or water. Season with salt, pepper, and a bay leaf. Cover and cook over low heat for 1 hour. Add the diced potatoes and cook for another 20 minutes or until tender. Serve warm.

name: Oven-Baked Chicken with Potatoes
description: Chicken thighs roasted over seasoned potatoes with a garlicky, creamy sauce.
instructions: Peel and slice the potatoes (≈0.5 cm thick). Toss in a bowl with olive oil, salt, and thyme.
Pour 2-3 tbsp of olive oil into a baking tray. Slice the 4 onions and spread them evenly in the tray. Layer the seasoned potatoes on top.
Blend the garlic (5 cloves), milk, sunflower oil, tomato paste, paprika, thyme, salt, and pepper until you get a smooth sauce.
Place the chicken thighs over the potatoes, pour the sauce over the meat, and tuck in the asparagus and the whole garlic head. Bake at 220°C for 60 minutes. Serve immediately.

name: Penne Quattro Formaggi
description: A rich, cheesy penne pasta made with four kinds of melted cheese.
instructions: Boil 250g penne according to package instructions, about 8 minutes until al dente.

Separately, prepare the sauce. Melt butter in a pan and add cream, salt and pepper to taste. Cut the cheeses into small pieces if not already grated, and when the cream starts to boil, add them to the pan. Mix everything for 5 minutes until all ingredients have melted and combined perfectly.
Let the sauce thicken for 2-3 more minutes on low heat. Add the penne using two spatulas and mix well. Sprinkle with oregano before serving.

name: Pasta Arrabiata
description: A spicy Italian pasta with a fiery tomato and hot pepper sauce.
instructions: Boil spaghetti in salted water for about 8 minutes until al dente, then rinse under cold water.

Separately, prepare the sauce. Clean the hot peppers from seeds, slice them into 2-3 cm pieces and put them in a pan with 4-5 tbsp oil. Add finely chopped garlic and let everything sauté for 3 minutes. Deglaze with a little water and add the tomato sauce.
In 10 minutes the arrabiata sauce is almost ready. Add lemon juice, parmesan and 2 tbsp olive oil. Mix the pasta with the sauce and serve with grated parmesan on top.

name: Pasta with Chicken and Pesto
description: Pasta tossed with grilled chicken, homemade basil pesto, and cherry tomatoes.
instructions: Remove chicken from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking to reach room temperature. Boil the pasta and prepare the pesto sauce. Using a blender, blend raw basil, cashews, garlic, parmesan, 2 tbsp olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper to taste.

When the pesto sauce is ready, lightly brush the chicken breast pieces with it and let them reach room temperature for 20-30 minutes. Using a suitable pan, heat 2 tbsp olive oil and cook the meat until fully fried. Add cherry tomatoes and sauté for 5 minutes.
When the chicken breast is ready, cut it into thin pieces and mix with the pasta, sauce, and cherry tomatoes. Serve with grated parmesan on top.

name: Pasta with Shrimp
description: A garlicky shrimp pasta finished with lemon and white wine flavors.
instructions: Boil water and when it starts to boil, add the pasta. Separately, peel the shrimp by first removing the head, then the shell and intestine. Don't throw away the remains; boil them in a little water just to cover them. Let them boil for a few minutes, then strain the broth into a glass as you will need it later.

While the shrimp broth is cooking, heat oil, butter, garlic, and finely chopped hot pepper in a pan. Mix gently for 3 minutes. Add the shrimp and let them sauté for 2 minutes. When the shrimp turn pink, add a glass of the broth and let everything boil for 3-4 minutes.
Add lemon juice, salt and pepper. Mix well and finally add the pasta and parsley to the pan. Serve with grated parmesan on top and a glass of white wine.

name: Pasta with Garlic and Hot Pepper
description: A simple, spicy pasta tossed in garlic, hot pepper, and olive oil.
instructions: Boil the spaghetti according to package instructions. Meanwhile, slice the pepper and garlic, and finely chop the parsley. Sauté the garlic and pepper in olive oil for a few minutes.

Add 2 ladles of the pasta cooking water, then add the finely chopped parsley. Leave the pan on the heat for a few minutes and finally add the cooked pasta to the pan. Season with salt and basil. Mix everything well and serve with grated parmesan on top.

name: Baked Salmon with Asparagus
description: Oven-baked salmon fillets with a garlicky lemon-herb sauce and roasted asparagus.
instructions: Preheat the oven and grease a baking tray with olive oil. Place the salmon fillets and season with salt and pepper.
Mix olive oil, garlic, herbs, and juice from half a lemon. Pour this sauce over the salmon fillets, ensuring it covers all surfaces.

Wash the asparagus and cut off the woody stems. Arrange asparagus around the edges with salmon in the center and drizzle with olive oil. Slice the remaining lemon thinly and cover each piece of salmon with a slice.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the fish is opaque and flaky when tested with a fork. Garnish with fresh thyme or parsley and serve alongside the asparagus.

name: Baked Salmon with Vegetables
description: Buttery baked salmon served alongside a medley of roasted vegetables.
instructions: Remove salmon from refrigerator and let it reach room temperature for about 15 minutes. Preheat the oven. In a small bowl, mix melted butter and lemon juice.
Using a brush, apply the butter mixture over the salmon fillets in a baking dish. Sprinkle with chopped garlic, salt, and pepper. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, cut the vegetables according to their density so they cook evenly. Cauliflower can remain medium-sized florets, while broccoli should be separated into smaller florets. Place vegetables with cut side down in another baking tray and drizzle with olive oil. Bake vegetables for 30 minutes. When done, sprinkle with fresh parsley and dill. Serve the salmon alongside the roasted vegetables.

name: Classic Beef Soup
description: A traditional, hearty beef and vegetable soup simmered until tender.
instructions: Wash and clean the vegetables, then cut the carrots into rounds, and dice the celery, bell pepper, and potatoes. Finely chop the onion.

Put approximately 4 liters of water in a pot and add the diced beef. Let the meat boil until foam forms on top (approximately 20 minutes), which you will remove with a skimmer. Let the meat boil for another 20-30 minutes, removing foam occasionally.
Once no more foam forms, add the onion, carrots, and celery and let them boil for another 20-30 minutes. Then add the bell pepper, peas, and potatoes and let them boil for 15 minutes.
Once cooked, add the tomato juice, a little salt and olive oil, and let the soup boil for another 15 minutes. When the soup is ready, add the chopped parsley and serve.

name: Sour Beef Soup
description: A tangy Romanian-style beef soup soured with bors and topped with sour cream.
instructions: Start by putting the beef on the bone to boil in cold water with salt. Boil the meat over low heat while removing the foam that forms on the surface. Meanwhile, prepare the root vegetables. Clean, wash and finely chop the onion, and cut the carrots, celery, and parsley root into cubes.

Once no more foam forms, pierce the meat with a fork to see if it's cooked more than halfway. Then add the root vegetables. Let the soup boil over low heat while you prepare the remaining vegetables. Cut the pepper into cubes, peel and cube the potatoes.

Once the root vegetables start to soften, add the pepper, peas, and finely chopped white cabbage. Check if the meat is cooked. When the fork goes in easily, remove it from the pot, let it cool slightly, then cut into cubes. Put the meat back in the pot.
When the vegetables are almost cooked, add the potatoes. Once they're cooked, add the tomatoes that you've previously scalded, peeled, and cubed.

Boil the bors separately and add it to the soup. Let the contents come to two boils and remove the pot from heat. Add salt and pepper to taste, as well as finely chopped lovage. Serve with a little sour cream.

name: Transylvanian Veal Soup with Sour Cream
description: A rich veal soup finished with an egg yolk and sour cream mixture.
instructions: Start by putting the veal to boil together with the veal bones in a pot with cold water, salt, and a few peppercorns. Let the meat boil for approximately 45 minutes, during which you will skim constantly until the broth remains clear.

Meanwhile, wash and clean the vegetables. Cut the potatoes into cubes, carrots into rounds, parsnip, parsley root, and celery into cubes, and finely chop the onion. Add two tablespoons of oil to a pan and briefly sauté the carrots.

When the meat is almost cooked, remove it from the pot and cut into cubes. Strain the soup separately into another pot, add the veal and prepared vegetables. Let everything boil and add celery and parsley leaves. When the veal soup boils, add the thyme sprig, bay leaf, pepper, and a little ground cumin. Then add two level tablespoons of sweet paprika and tomato juice. Let everything boil until the vegetables are soft.

When the veal soup is cooked, remove the celery leaves and thyme sprig. Prepare the egg yolk and sour cream mixture: Mix the sour cream with the egg yolks and 2 tablespoons of soup until the mixture thins, then add it to the soup and mix well. Optionally, add a little lemon juice to taste.

name: Country-Style Beef Soup
description: A rustic, vegetable-packed beef soup with a tangy tomato and bors broth.
instructions: Remove the meat from the bone and wash it well, then cut it into cubes. Put the cubed meat and bones to boil in a pot with water and salt for approximately one hour. Skim constantly until the broth remains clear. The meat should be soft when pierced with a fork.

Meanwhile, prepare the vegetables and remove the bones from the pot. Wash, clean, and cut the carrots, onion, potatoes, bell pepper, parsnip root, and celery. Finely chop the white cabbage. Add the cut vegetables to the pot where the meat is boiling (without potatoes), along with the peas and green beans. Let the soup boil over low heat.

When the vegetables and meat are tender, add the potatoes and let them boil for approximately 20 minutes. Then add the tomatoes in broth and bors to taste. Let it come to a few boils and add salt to taste. When ready, remove the pot from heat and add finely chopped lovage and parsley.

name: Classic Tomato Soup
description: A traditional Romanian tomato soup made with fresh tomatoes and root vegetables.
instructions: Blanch the tomatoes in boiling water for 2-3 minutes, then peel them and remove the woody part near the stem. Put the tomatoes in a pot with water to cover, bay leaves, thyme sprigs, and basil sprigs, and boil for 15-20 minutes.

Meanwhile, peel and finely dice the carrots, onions, celery, parsnip, both bell peppers, and garlic. In a large pot, sauté all the diced vegetables over low heat until softened, then add 250 ml of water.

Once the tomatoes have finished boiling, remove them, discard the herbs, and blend the tomatoes into a smooth paste. Add the tomato paste to the sautéed vegetables and top up with water. Simmer until the soup reaches the desired consistency, then season with salt and pepper. Serve with sour cream and chopped fresh herbs on top.

name: Tomato Soup with Homemade Noodles
description: A hearty tomato soup made even more satisfying with fresh, hand-cut egg noodles.
instructions: First prepare the noodle dough: beat the egg in a bowl, then pour it into the center of the flour mixed with a pinch of salt. Combine and knead into a dough, adding a splash of warm water if it's too stiff. Let the dough rest for 30 minutes.

While it rests, peel and dice the carrots, bell pepper, onion, celery, and parsnip, then sauté them in oil for a few minutes until soft and add water to cover. Meanwhile, boil the tomatoes in water for 2-3 minutes, peel them, and blend into a smooth paste, then add it to the simmering vegetables.
Roll the rested dough into a thin sheet, let it dry for 30 minutes, then roll it up and slice into thin strips to make the noodles.
Sprinkle the noodles into the simmering soup like rain, stirring so they don't stick together, and cook for 10 minutes. Season with salt, pepper, and chopped fresh parsley before serving.

name: Tomato Soup with Semolina Dumplings
description: A well-known meatless Romanian soup, tangy and filling thanks to fluffy semolina dumplings.
instructions: Finely chop the onion and sauté it in oil for 2-3 minutes until soft. Dice the carrots and add them to the pot along with 3 liters of water, letting everything boil over high heat. Thinly slice the garlic and add it along with the chopped parsley, then let it all boil for 15-20 minutes. Pour in the tomato juice and let the soup continue simmering.
Meanwhile, prepare the dumplings: in a separate bowl, beat the eggs, season with salt and pepper, then sift in the semolina, mixing well so no lumps form. Let the mixture rest for 4-5 minutes.

Turn off the heat under the soup and drop spoonfuls of the dumpling mixture into it. Once all the dumplings are added, bring the soup back to a gentle simmer until the dumplings have puffed up and the vegetables are fully cooked. Season with salt and pepper to taste before serving.

name: Cream of Tomato Soup
description: A tangy, velvety blended tomato soup packed with root vegetables and potatoes.
instructions: Wash and peel the vegetables for the soup base (carrots, onion, garlic, bell pepper, parsnip, and celery), then dice them finely. Sauté the diced vegetables in a large pot for 3-4 minutes, then add about 4 liters of water. Cube the potatoes and zucchini and add them to the pot to boil along with the other vegetables.
Meanwhile, boil the tomatoes for 5-6 minutes so they're easy to peel. Once cooled and peeled, blend them with a hand blender or grate them into a smooth paste.
When the vegetables are fully cooked, remove them from the broth and blend them into a fine paste as well. Mix this vegetable paste back into the broth, then stir in the tomato paste.
Let the cream soup simmer for a few minutes, then season with salt, pepper, and other spices to taste. Serve with a few croutons, sour cream, and chopped parsley.

name: Tomato Soup with Garlic
description: A fragrant tomato soup infused with plenty of garlic, basil, and thyme.
instructions: Wash the tomatoes and cut them in half, then boil them for a few minutes until they soften well. Once they start to peel easily, pass them through a fine sieve to obtain a smooth paste.

In a separate pot, heat the oil for 1-2 minutes, then sauté the finely chopped garlic and onion for 5 minutes. Add the tomato paste along with the dried thyme and basil sprigs, and let everything simmer for 15 minutes. Add water and salt depending on how thick you want the soup, and let it come to a boil.

Cover the pot with a lid and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes. Finally, remove the basil sprigs and blend the whole soup with a mixer or hand blender until smooth. Serve with grated parmesan and croutons.

name: Gazpacho
description: A refreshing, chilled Spanish-style tomato and vegetable soup, perfect for hot summer days.
instructions: Soak the bread slices in water until soft. Meanwhile, wash, peel, and dice the tomatoes, cucumbers, bell pepper, onion, and garlic.

Place all the vegetables in a blender and blend until the mixture becomes a smooth paste. Add the soaked bread slices, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and freshly ground pepper, then continue blending until fully combined.
Chill the gazpacho in the refrigerator for a few hours before serving with a few croutons or grated parmesan on top.

name: Turkish Tomato Soup
description: A simple, quick tomato soup thickened with a light flour roux and finished with milk.
instructions: Heat the oil in a suitably sized pot. Add the flour and let it brown lightly for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly. Pour the tomato juice over the flour and oil mixture and let it cook until it comes to a boil.

Once the juice starts boiling, add the salt, dried basil, and dried oregano. Lower the heat and slowly pour in the milk, stirring carefully with a wooden spoon. Let the soup cook for another 5-10 minutes, then serve with a few spoonfuls of grated cheese on top.
